client.label: Clients
client.blurb: Where requests start. Its region is where your users are.

cdn.label: CDN
cdn.blurb: Answers cacheable reads at an edge location near users.

lb.label: Load balancer
lb.blurb: Spreads requests across the servers behind it.

gateway.label: API gateway
gateway.blurb: Auth, rate limits and routing in front of your services.

app.label: App server
app.blurb: Runs your request handlers. Scale out with replicas.

worker.label: Worker
worker.blurb: Pulls jobs from a queue and processes them in the background.

cache.label: Cache
cache.blurb: In-memory store for hot reads. Misses fall through to the database.

db.label: Database
db.blurb: Primary database. Takes every write and any reads sent to it.

replica.label: Read replica
replica.blurb: Read-only copy of the primary. Takes reads and replays every write.

queue.label: Queue
queue.blurb: Accepts work now and hands it to workers at their own pace.

storage.label: Object storage
storage.blurb: Files and media, S3-style. A share of reads fetch from it.

external.label: Third-party API
external.blurb: A service you call but do not run, such as payments or email.

presets.name: Steady weekday
presets.note: Normal working-hours load with small bumps.

presets.name: Evening peak
presets.note: The busiest hour of a normal day.

presets.name: Flash sale
presets.note: Short spikes at 3x while carts and orders surge.

presets.name: Launch day
presets.note: Traffic climbs all day after a big announcement.

presets.name: Write-heavy ingest
presets.note: Devices or logs pushing data in constantly.

templates.name: Classic three-tier web app
templates.blurb: A load balancer, a pool of app servers, a cache and one database. The usual starting point.

templates.name: Read-heavy content site
templates.blurb: CDN at the edge, a cache and a read replica. Built for feeds, blogs and catalogs.

templates.name: Write-heavy ingest pipeline
templates.blurb: An API gateway in front, a queue to soak up bursts, workers writing to the database.

templates.name: E-commerce checkout
templates.blurb: A payments API on the request path, order emails sent by background workers.

templates.name: Single-server MVP
templates.blurb: One app server and one database. Cheap and simple, and a quick way to see what breaks first.

templates.name: Photo sharing
templates.blurb: Uploads go to object storage and images are served from a CDN.
